item: Art. 18 substantial modification: who is the manufacturer
what_the_source_says: (1) the person carrying out the substantial modification is considered the manufacturer, with Art. 10 duties; (2) that person must ensure and declare on its sole responsibility conformity and apply the Art. 25(2), (3) or (4) procedure; (3) a non-professional user modifying own machinery for personal use is not considered a manufacturer.

Manufacturers must ensure the product is designed and constructed in line with the Annex III essential health and safety requirements ("shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed" per extraction).

item: Art. 10(2) technical documentation, conformity assessment, declaration, CE
what_the_source_says: Manufacturers draw up the Annex IV Part A technical documentation and carry out the conformity assessment; if compliance is shown they draw up the EU declaration and affix CE marking.

item: Art. 10(3) retention 10 years and source code on request
what_the_source_says: Retention: "for at least 10 years after the machinery or the related product [...]" (extraction quote, applies to technical documentation and EU declaration). Source code or programming logic included in the technical documentation to be provided on reasoned request, where needed to check compliance with Annex III.
Products conforming to harmonised standards (references published in the OJ) are presumed to conform to the Annex III requirements those standards cover.
